open_points.subject: runtime settings load
open_points.question: Which capability calls `capability:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings`, and which capability passes its result to `capability:configuration.load_configuration`?
options: `instance_lifecycle.start_instance` calls both capabilities and passes the settings
open_points.default_guess: Have `configuration.load_configuration` call `runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings`, because `configuration` knows `runtime_settings` and presents one start-check operation.

open_points.subject: per-item settings validation
open_points.text: `runtime_settings` hides “the closed environment table and its per-item validation”, while `configuration` owns “each well formed” check and `runtime_settings` “Must not own” only checks across items
open_points.question: Which module validates the form of each individual environment item, and what validation, if any, occurs while loading it?
options: `runtime_settings` performs each per-item form validation and `configuration` performs only cross-item checks
`runtime_settings` copies declared items without validation and `configuration` performs every form check
`runtime_settings` performs representation parsing while `configuration` performs semantic well-formedness checks, with that boundary stated explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Let `runtime_settings` copy the declared values without refusing them and let `configuration` perform every well-formedness check, matching `flow:start_instance`.

open_points.subject: confirmation eligibility for imported names and aliases
open_points.text: State 4 says, “Only when the mapping shows no malformed record, no conflict and no missing value, `capability:owner_sessions.show_confirmation_step`”, while A16 says, “nor while a name or alias the owner gives breaks A02”
open_points.question: Must an otherwise complete mapping with an invalid owner-given name or alias be refused before the confirmation step is shown?
options: Refuse the confirmation step whenever an owner-given name or alias fails A02
Show the confirmation step because only malformed source records, conflicts and missing values gate it, then reject at confirmation
Treat invalid owner-given names and aliases as `malformed record` and state that explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Refuse before showing the confirmation step and state invalid owner-given names or aliases as a separate gate.

witness.initial: An owner session holds a readable import file whose selected records have no conflict or malformed source record.
events: The owner selects a project and gives it an alias of 41 Unicode code points.
The owner asks Registry to show the import confirmation step.
outcomes: Registry refuses to show the step because the alias fails A02.
Registry shows a confirmation step because the mapping has no malformed record, conflict or missing value.
witness.observer: The owner using the owner interface

open_points.subject: backup look interval
open_points.text: The flow says `capability:backups.run_daily_backup_if_due` is “called by `module:instance_lifecycle` at least once a minute”; State 3 says the minute-look constant is one that “`backups` applies”, while `instance_lifecycle` owns “the minute look of `backups`”
open_points.question: Which module imports and applies `BACKUP_LOOK_SECONDS` to schedule calls of `run_daily_backup_if_due`?
options: `instance_lifecycle` imports the constant and schedules the calls
`backups` imports the constant and owns a deterministic timer that invokes its check
`instance_lifecycle` schedules a fixed one-minute timer while `backups` imports the constant for a separate check
open_points.default_guess: Have `instance_lifecycle` import `BACKUP_LOOK_SECONDS` and use it for the timer, while `backups` owns only the due decision.
